podcast_mp3.description: Convert raw audio/video to podcast MP3

youtube_mp4.command: ffmpeg -i INPUT.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -b:v 20M -maxrate 25M -bufsize 40M -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart OUTPUT.mp4

tiktok_vertical.command: ffmpeg -i INPUT.mp4 -vf 'crop=1080:1920:(iw-1080)/2:(ih-1920)/2,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1080:1920:-1:-1:color=black' -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -b:v 8M -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart OUTPUT.mp4

podcast_from_video.description: Extract audio from video and convert to podcast MP3

thumbnail_gif.description: Generate animated GIF thumbnail for social

batch_tiktok_clips.description: Batch process long video into 60s TikTok clips
batch_tiktok_clips.command: ffmpeg -i INPUT.mp4 -ss 00:01:00 -t 60 -vf 'crop=1080:1920:(iw-1080)/2:(ih-1920)/2,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1080:1920:-1:-1:color=black' -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -b:v 8M -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 clip_01.mp4
